book.name: Filipenses
book.title: Pablo carta agaja filiposnumia aidau awetimu

content: Shiig aneenisa batsatbau

Cristo atumin tikich wakemitkatan senchijin amasua nujai nuigtú anentak atumiin ajutjamaina nujai tikich aidaush anentai ichichtugtajum, nuniakjum makichik Wakania duke ajutjamaina dui pempeentunisjumek wait anendaitajum;
nuniakjum minash shiig anemtijustajum ashí ijutkau pujakjum, makichik anenka nuig ijunkujum, makichik anentaimta nuig, takastasa anentaimtamua dusha makichik anentaimtakjum.
Makichkish shiwagmagata tabauwai takasaigpa, nuniachkugmesh ememamuikish, duka nunitsuk ayatak imanchauch anenmamkujum makí makichkitijum tikich aidaush atumin nagkaetamsau diitajum.
Makichkish imá ni wakegamujiya nuna egatsuk, ashí tikich aidau wakegamua nuna egaktinme.
Cristo imanchau wajasú ashí nagkaekagtasu awajsamu
Atumnash Cristo Jesús anentaimajakua nuninuk anentaimtash ajutjamain ainawai;

content.text: nigka Apajuí wajukuita ibau aajakuitak, Apajuijai betek atasag wakekachui;
ni aajakbauwa nunak idaiyak jutiijai betek wajas, ashí aents aidau inataijiya nunin wajasui;
nunik aentsjai betek wajas nigki imanchauch wajasui,
nunik jaakush Apajuí umijak, cruznum jakauwai.
Nunikmatai Apajuishkam imá niinak ememattai awasauwai,
dutika daajinash ashí tikich aidau daaji aina nuna nagkaesaun susauwai;
nuigtú nugká initkenia aidaushkam imá Jesucristunak tikishmatug ememattinme tusa;
nuninak ashí nugkanmaya aidaush Jesucristo Apua nuna dekaatnume,
nunikag iina Apají Apajuiya nunak ememattinme tusa.

content: Nuadui mina aneetaig yatsug aidauh, wi atsakuish tuke umigtin agmaujum nunisjumek, yamai wi atushat pujag juish aan nagkaemasjum umigtuktajum. Atum uwemjamu dekaskea duke puyatjusjum kuitamkatajum;
wagki Apajuiya nuuwai wakeetan nuigtú ni wakega dutiksaik wakejusa takatan atumin amá duka.
Ashí dutikatajum makichkish augmatnaitsuk nuigtush jiyanitsuk;

makichkish nuninai tama amainchau, bakumamainjish atsugbau, Apajuí uchijí asajum pegkegchaush atsugbau, aents pegkegchau besekú aina nuig, atum agkajunum yaya aidau etsantak nugkan tsaaptin emama numamtin atajum.
Chicham pujutan sukagtina nuanuig ebetmamjatajum, nuniau asagmin Cristo minakuish, atumiin ememasan anentaimjatjai, wainkanuk wekaesachuapitja nuigtush wainkanuk takaschauwapitja tusan.
Nuniau asan, dekaskeapi tabauwai atum takaamu ofrenda Apajuí sumaina numamtuk wajajum nujai betek atatui wi mantamnamush, nunikmatai atumjai shiig aneakun dakujamu ajuttatui.
Nunin asamtai atumshakam shiig aneakjum wijai dakujustajum.
Timoteo
Apu Jesús wakegakuig, Timoteon wamak atumiin awemata tajai, atum wajuk pujagme nuna dekaan shiig aneastasan.
Wagki tikichik wi uyumag imatika atumdau pegkeg amaina nuna uyumauk atsawai.
Wagki ashí tikich aidauk, Cristo Jesús wakega nuna egatsuk dita wakegamua nunak egainawai.
Tujash atumek dekagme Timoteo pujutji pegkeja duka, nuigtush wajuk wijai takasé yamajam chicham etsegbaunum, mina uchig yainmaina imatika.
Nunin asamtai minash wajuk ajuttig nuna dekaan awematag tajai;
Apu Jesusai kajintsan anentaimjai nuniau asan wisha waamak minittajai.
Epafrodito
Dutiksanuk yatsug Epafrodito awetitag tajime, mina takat atuetutaig, nuigtú yamajam chicham etsegbaunmash senchi takaak, nuigtú wi atsumamunmash yainka nuna.
Nigka shiig senchi wakemayi atumin ashí waipakagtatus, nuniayatak shiig senchi waittsabi atum jaawai tabau antukchamkaijum nuna.
Dekaskenmag jamayi, jatanum jeganmayi, tujash Apajuí niinak wait anenjabi, imá niinakek dutikache, minashkam wait anenjuje, wake besemag pujag nuna, nuní nagkaemas wake besemag pujusai tujutu asa.
Nuadui wamkesan awetajime, atumshakam ataktú ni wainkajum shiig aneastajum, nuniakjumin wishakam wake besemjak pujushtajai, tusan.
Shiig aneasjum Apu Jesusa daajin jukitajum, nuniakjum tikich niiya junin aidaushkam aneasjum diistajum;
wagki Cristo takagbaunum jatanum jeganmayi, niina pujutinak ishamainnum idaisabi atum mina yainmaina nuna ni yainkata tau asa.
